replace: // the page <title> reads this: the engine's own revision, so every
// install titles itself "LCLite - <rev>" with nothing to template
// custom: the management page is a config editor with NO authentication —
// PUT /setup/config rewrites this world's own world.json — and upstream binds
// it to 0.0.0.0, so every machine that can reach the port can rewrite this
// world's settings. Loopback by default; MANAGEMENT_HOST=0.0.0.0 opts back in
// for a host who really means to publish it (the launcher refuses to list a
// world while that page answers on a LAN address).
await management.listen({ port: Environment.web.managementPort, host: managementHost });
